props.name: 地铁入口电子显示屏
props.design: Illuminated electronic sign above subway entrance, dark plastic frame with bright LED dot matrix displaying 'First Train Arriving' text, cool blue-white light, slightly weathered surface, front view, placed above dark subway stairwell, matching pre-dawn cool ambient lighting, atmospheric urban realism style.

props.name: 首班地铁列车
props.design: Sleek silver urban subway train with smooth streamlined body, warm yellow interior lights glowing through windows, slight motion blur when entering station, side tracking view, wet ground reflection under soft streetlamp light, naturalistic color grading, low contrast cinematic look.

props.name: 地铁内品牌数字屏
props.design: Matte black framed digital screen inside subway train, displaying brand logo and 'Start Your Day' slogan in bright white anti-glare text, front close-up view, surrounded by warm interior train lighting, subtle overall haze effect, minimalist design.

scenes.name: 凌晨沉睡城市街景
scenes.design: Wide urban street scene at 5:30 AM, dark skyscrapers with scattered lit windows, wet pavement with faint reflections, white steam rising slowly from sewer vent, cool deep indigo and blue-gray tones, soft pre-dawn ambient light, wide establishing shot, minimalist atmospheric urban realism style.

scenes.name: 渐亮城市天际线
scenes.design: Long shot of city skyline against gradually brightening dawn sky, color shifting from deep indigo to soft warm golden, faint haze in the air, skyscraper silhouettes, low contrast natural color grading, wide view emphasizing the gradual awakening of the city, cinematic lighting.

scenes.name: 空荡地铁站台
scenes.design: Empty subway station platform at early dawn, cool fluorescent station lights, clean tiled floor with faint reflections, dark tunnel entrance in the distance, soft ambient lighting, medium long shot, quiet minimalist atmosphere matching slow cinema style, desaturated cool shadows.
